identitySignals: Name matches registered nonprofit 'Ultimate Impact Inc' in Oakland, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 81-4505027), matching the agenda's 'Oakland, CA'
Organization website (ultimate-impact.org) lists its office at 1025 Yerba Buena Ave, Oakland, CA and the same tax ID 81-4505027

Website describes youth programming in Oakland schools, consistent with OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' category; a public Eat.Learn.Play. Foundation page describes the organization's work with OUSD students at West Oakland Middle School
research.notes: No agenda link to Prescott Elementary specifically was found online; identity rests on name, Oakland location, EIN/website match and documented work with OUSD students. General email appears on the contact page only in obfuscated form, so it was omitted. No phone number listed.

profile.summary: Ultimate Impact is a nonprofit that uses the sport of ultimate Frisbee to support youth from underrepresented communities in San Francisco and Oakland. Its programs run in schools and include play-based programs, leadership programs, a competitive team and a summer camp. It aims to help young people build confidence, teamwork and accountability.

sources.title: Ultimate Impact Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Oakland youth nonprofit Ultimate Impact Inc (EIN 81-4505027, 1025 Yerba Buena Ave) matches the agenda name and city, and a no-cost youth sports services agreement at an elementary school fits its mission; no link to Prescott specifically was found. Name, EIN, address, org type and program list are confirmed on ProPublica and the organization's site, and the San Francisco/Oakland and partner-school wording appears on its program pages.
